Why go: Koh Phangan's coast on your own schedule

Koh Phangan's best beaches and coves are on the north and east coasts, where the ferries don't go. With your own speedboat for a full day you can snorkel off Koh Ma, have lunch at a beach of your choice and still have time for a second or third stop, all without changing boats or waiting for a timetable.

This is a simple single-engine boat without a toilet, priced for small groups. For two to five people it is one of the most affordable ways to spend a whole day on Koh Phangan by private boat.

Planning your day

Eight hours is long enough for three stops. A typical plan is snorkelling in the morning when the water is clearest, lunch at a beach restaurant around midday, and an afternoon on a quiet beach before the run back to Samui. Tell us the beaches you are interested in when you book; the captain confirms what the sea allows on the day. Because the price covers up to 5 guests, it is one of the cheapest full-day private boats to Koh Phangan for a small group.

Who it suits

  • Couples and small groups of up to 5.
  • Confident swimmers and snorkellers.
  • Travellers who want to explore Koh Phangan beyond the ferry piers.

Who should choose something else

  • Families with infants or anyone pregnant.
  • Groups that need a toilet on board: the Gulf Nomad has one.
  • Anyone who just needs to get to Koh Phangan: see ferries and transfers.

Good to know

  • Comfort: single-engine boats are slower and bumpier than twin-engine boats. Sit at the back in chop.
  • Park and beach fees: some beaches and viewpoints charge small cash fees.
  • Booking: online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thai time.
